An Arrabal is a Spanish and Portuguese word for an area on the periphery of a city or large town, a suburb. It may also refer to:Bruno Arrabal, Brazilian footballer

Arrabal (Zaragoza), a district in Zaragoza, Spain
Arrabal (Leiria), a parish (freguesia) in Leiria, Portugal
